requirements.quote: Party names that differ from the graph beyond alias rules are flagged `error`; alias and honorific variants are accepted silently [type:unit]
Case numbers are normalised across at least 10 notation variants per launch court and mismatches against the proceeding are flagged with the expected value [type:unit]
Dates are parsed from Indian formats and ordinals; a date that contradicts the listing or order date in the graph is flagged with both values [type:unit]
Annexure references are cross-checked: missing annexure, duplicate number, gap in sequence and unreferenced attached document each yield a distinct rule id [type:unit]
Every finding carries the draft span, the graph fact and its provenance (source type and anchor), so the UI can show a Provenance Chip [type:unit]
`applyFix` changes the draft only after an explicit confirmation call and creates a new `draft_version`; there is no auto-apply path [type:api]
The checker is deterministic and makes no AI calls; a static test asserts the package imports nothing from `packages/ai` under `consistency/` [type:unit]
A draft of 30 pages checks in under 2 s p95 on seeded data [type:unit]
Findings are scoped by workspace; the checker cannot read matters from other workspaces (cross-tenant suite) [type:api]
Tamil and Kannada names are compared after Unicode normalisation (NFC) and are not flagged for script differences alone when an alias exists [type:unit]
Report is idempotent for the same `draft_version_id` and invalidated when the graph facts change (new listing, order) [type:api]
It proposes nothing automatically: a finding offers "fix to graph value" as a lawyer-confirmed edit (L2), never an auto-apply.
report content is privileged matter data; do not log spans.

decisions.choice: The pure checker lives in packages/drafting (checkDraft over supplied facts); the issue's checkConsistency(tx, wsId, draftVersionId) loader lives in core consistency-service.ts.
decisions.justification: packages/drafting has no db dependency (packages/drafting/package.json:13-22) and slot resolution already follows the pure-resolver plus core loader split (packages/core/src/drafting/service.ts:243, packages/drafting/src/slots.ts:1-3).

decisions.choice: The job is defined in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions, not apps/worker/src/jobs.
decisions.justification: apps/worker/src/jobs does not exist; jobs are registered in packages/core/src/jobs/registry.ts:48,189 and the worker guard is apps/worker/src/__tests__/registry.test.ts:146.

decisions.choice: Annexure P-n maps to the n-th kind='annexure' document of the matter ordered by (created_at, id); no new document column.
decisions.justification: document has no label or number column and no draft link (packages/db/src/schema/documents.ts:71-100); adding one is outside the issue.

decisions.choice: New table draft_consistency_report stores the report keyed by (draft_version_id, graph_revision) where graph_revision is a sha256 of the canonical facts.
decisions.justification: Idempotency and invalidation on new listing or order need a stored revision; draft_version is immutable so a report cannot live on it (packages/db/src/schema/drafting.ts:97-123, draft_export precedent at :125-160).

decisions.choice: No new workspace package dependency: drafting already depends on validators; core already depends on drafting (packages/core/package.json:66). Tests live in packages/drafting/src/consistency/__tests__ rather than packages/drafting/test.
decisions.justification: Existing drafting tests sit under src/**/__tests__ (packages/drafting/src/__tests__/engine.test.ts).
